question: Who takes the salute during the Republic Day parade at New Delhi?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**President**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Chief Guest For Republic Day, 2024:**President Emmanuel Macron** of France graces the occasion as the esteemed Chief Guest, fostering international camaraderie.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Republic Day****​**

 
 
• **Republic Day is celebrated every year on the 26th of January**.
 
• It marks the day when the Constitution of India came into effect in 1950, **replacing the Government of India Act (1935)** as the governing document of India.
 
• On this day, India officially became a sovereign, democratic republic, and its people chose their government.
 
• The Republic Day celebration in India is a grand event with various ceremonial parades, cultural performances, and the iconic Republic Day parade held at Rajpath in New Delhi.
 
• **The President of India hoists the national flag**, and various achievements of the nation are showcased during the celebrations.
 
• The Presiden takes the salute during the Republic Day parade at New Delhi.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• Historical Background: India gained independence from British colonial rule on August 15, 1947. However, it was on January 26, 1950, that India adopted its Constitution, becoming a fully sovereign and democratic republic.
 
• Adoption of the Constitution: The Constituent Assembly of India, under the leadership of Dr. B. R. Ambedkar, worked diligently to draft the Constitution of India, which took almost three years to complete.
 
 
• The Constitution was adopted on November 26, 1949, and came into effect on January 26, 1950.
 
 
 
• Purna Swaraj Declaration: Interestingly, January 26 has a historical significance even before the adoption of the Constitution.
 
 
• On January 26, 1930, the Indian National Congress declared the "Purna Swaraj" (Complete Independence) resolution, marking the demand for complete self-rule and freedom from British rule.
 
 
 
• **Republic Day Celebrations**: The Republic Day celebrations in India are marked by various events, with the main parade held in the national capital, New Delhi. The President of India takes the salute at the Republic Day parade, which showcases the country's military might, cultural diversity, achievements, and socio-economic progress.
 
• Chief Guest: Each year, a **foreign head of state or a dignitary **is invited as the chief guest for the Republic Day parade.
 
 
• This tradition symbolizes **India's diplomatic ties and global friendships**.
 
 
 
• Flag Hoisting and Celebrations: Republic Day is celebrated throughout the country with enthusiasm and patriotic fervour. 
 
 
• The national flag is hoisted in **schools, government offices, and public places**.
 
• Cultural programs flag hoisting ceremonies, and parades are organized in various cities and towns.
 
 
 
• **Importance of the Constitution**
 
 
• ​Republic Day not only commemorates the adoption of the Constitution but also emphasizes the significance of the guiding principles and fundamental rights enshrined in it.
 
• The Constitution of India serves as the supreme law of the country, ensuring justice, liberty, equality, and fraternity for all citizens.
